direction-type.words: Whenever an election's on, we play on either side.
The way we play oor fine auld airs, fills Irish hearts wi' pride.
Oh if poor Tam Moore was livin' now, he'd mak' ye understand.
That nane could dae him justice like auld MacNamara's band.
We play at wakes and waddins an' at every country ball.
And at any great man's funeral wee'll play 'Dead March in Saul'.
When the Prince O' Wales tae Ireland cam' he shook me by the hand.
And said he'd never heard the like o' MacNamara's band.
Verse4: Richt now we're rehearsing for a verra swell affair.
The annual celebration a' the gentry will be there.
When General Grant tae Ireland cam' he took me by the hand.
Says he 'I never saw the like o' MacNamara's band.'
The Tottenham Hotspur football anthem uses the verse:
Oh the whistle blows, the cockerel crows, and now we're in the game.
It's up to you , you lillywhites to play the Tottenham way.
Oh there's many a team from many a town, and some are great and small.
But the famous Tottenham Hotspur are the greatest of them all.
